name: Saotome Otoko
source:
Otoko is Yuu’s sister. She’s a fashion-conscious young girl who’s obsessed with the way she looks.

She hates living in the countryside, and dreams of moving to Tokyo one day, where she can peruse as many fancy malls and buy as many expensive clothes as she can carry.

Though she bickers with her brother constantly, she’s kind and affectionate towards the family cat, Tama. It’s clear Otoko, for all her temper tantrums, does have a sweet side – but trying to uncover it is almost impossible.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=51275&p=492940#p492940]Lemma Soft[/url]]
